title: Add dev, build, start, lint, and test commands to CLI
body:
## Enhance CLI with Complete Development Workflow Commands

Based on the requirement to support mainstream development framework patterns, add the following commands to the Object UI CLI:

### Plan
- [x] Understand current CLI implementation
- [x] Add `dev` command - Start development server with hot reload
- [x] Add `build` command - Build application for production
- [x] Add `start` command - Serve production build
- [x] Add `lint` command - Lint the generated application code
- [x] Add `test` command - Run tests for the application
- [x] Extract shared utilities to app-generator module
- [x] Update CLI README documentation
- [x] Fix TypeScript and ESLint warnings
- [x] Address code review feedback
- [x] Fix CodeQL security issue - Add rate limiting
- [x] Test all commands work correctly
- [x] Ensure commands follow mainstream framework patterns (Next.js, Vite, etc.)

### Changes Made
- Created `/packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts` - Development server command
- Created `/packages/cli/src/commands/build.ts` - Production build command
- Created `/packages/cli/src/commands/start.ts` - Production server command with rate limiting
- Created `/packages/cli/src/commands/lint.ts` - Linting command with ESLint
- Created `/packages/cli/src/commands/test.ts` - Testing command with Vitest
- Created `/packages/cli/src/utils/app-generator.ts` - Shared utilities for app generation
- Updated `/packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` - Refactored to use shared utilities
- Updated `/packages/cli/src/cli.ts` - Added new command definitions
- Updated `/packages/cli/README.md` - Documented all commands
- Updated `/packages/cli/package.json` - Added express-rate-limit dependency
- Fixed all TypeScript and ESLint warnings
- Moved all imports to top level for consistency

### All Available Commands
1. **`objectui init`** - Initialize a new project
2. **`objectui dev`** - Development server with HMR
3. **`objectui build`** - Production build
4. **`objectui start`** - Serve production build (with rate limiting for security)
5. **`objectui lint`** - Lint code with ESLint
6. **`objectui test`** - Run tests with Vitest
7. **`objectui serve`** - Legacy development server (backward compatible)

### Security
- ✅ Added rate limiting to `start` command to prevent DoS attacks (1000 requests per IP per 15 minutes)
- ✅ Fixed CodeQL security alert: "Missing rate limiting" (js/missing-rate-limiting)
- ✅ Uses `express-rate-limit` middleware with standard headers

### Testing
All commands have been tested and verified to work correctly:
- ✅ `objectui init` - Creates new projects successfully
- ✅ `objectui dev` - Starts development server with hot reload
- ✅ `objectui build` - Builds for production
- ✅ `objectui start` - Serves production build with rate limiting protection
- ✅ `objectui lint` - Lints generated application code
- ✅ `objectui test` - Runs tests with multiple options (watch, coverage, UI)
- ✅ `objectui serve` - Legacy command still works

The CLI now follows mainstream framework patterns similar to Next.js, Vite, and other modern development tools, with enterprise-grade security features.
